answer: An agent marketplace requires every trading identity to lock a refundable bond for 30 days before accepting jobs, whether selling lotus seeds, sourcing copper, or repairing a stone ledge. The protocol limits each bonded identity to one active contract. Creating names is free, but gaining 1,000 simultaneous trading slots requires 1,000 bonds, tying up real capital for a month; splitting one stake across fake identities gains no extra capacity.
